EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Open reporting monitored during the period indicates that commercial shipping schedules show three cancelled port calls at Torvik for the period 15-18 August.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Torvik Harbour Authority, Aldenkirk.

3. Schedule data show 4 affected sailings, all within the period 0201Z to 0132Z.

4. The publication does not identify its own sourcing and gives no dateline beyond 1001Z.

5. Open reporting establishes that the event was publicly visible. It establishes nothing about military significance.
